text:
React -> Angular

useState ........... signal()
useMemo ............ computed()
useEffect .......... effect()
React.memo ......... OnPush / signals
React.lazy ......... lazy routes, @defer
React Query ........ TanStack Query (Angular)
Redux / Zustand .... NgRx Store / SignalStore
fetch + abort ...... HttpClient + switchMap
Context ............ DI services
Next.js SSR ........ Angular SSR +
                     incremental hydration
